name: 64055 · Independence, MO
findings: ZIP 64055 (Independence) has 125 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64055 (Independence) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 64055 (Independence) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
